note: Both sets share four significant mapping errors, swapping the reference keys for beams A1/A4 and B1/B4 (e.g., linking Grid 6 to A4 instead of A1). Set B is slightly better because it accurately captures the full label for beam C1 ('GRID 6 & NEAR GRID 5'), whereas Set A truncates it to 'GRID 6'. Additionally, Set A includes a redundant duplicate claim for the E6 beam, while Set B is more concise, though Set B misses the 'E6' key in its corresponding claim.
